$comment: ADR-504 building scale contract: how tall base building pieces draw against the player and the level grid (1x px, above the piece pivot = its ground point). Measured numbers live in building_scale.measured.json (tools/measure-building-scale.py). `floorLevels` MUST equal tiers.json building.levelHeight and @engine/world FLOOR_HEIGHT_LEVELS, and roofRfx.json levelPx MUST equal floorPx: one metric drives walls, decks, stairs and roof seats. `target` is the realistic set Art is asked for (docs/art-requests/ADR504_BUILDING_SCALE.md): 5 terrain levels (80 px) per floor, door openings a bit taller than the player. `pendingArt` lists pieces whose shipped art is not yet on the target floor (measured height pinned). ADR-511: Art's 80 px set (3bab4025) landed and the floor flipped to 5 levels / 80 px together with it; the list is empty and every scaled piece is held to its target.
